description: This file contains methods for the 'Iterator' class in the 'jsoniter' package, implementing JSON parsing and skipping functionalities.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: A class for iterating over JSON data, providing methods to read and skip JSON elements.

methods.name: ReadNil
methods.description: Reads a JSON null value and returns true if null, false otherwise.

methods.name: ReadBool
methods.description: Reads a boolean value ('true' or 'false') from JSON.

methods.name: SkipAndReturnBytes
methods.description: Skips the next JSON element and returns its content as a byte slice.

methods.name: SkipAndAppendBytes
methods.description: Skips the next JSON element and appends its content to a provided buffer.

methods.name: startCaptureTo
methods.description: Begins capturing JSON data into a buffer starting at a specific position.

methods.name: startCapture
methods.description: Begins capturing JSON data into a new buffer.

methods.name: stopCapture
methods.description: Stops capturing and returns the captured data as a byte slice.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips over the next JSON element, handling different JSON types.

methods.name: skipFourBytes
methods.description: Skips four specific bytes in JSON, used for skipping specific literals.

methods.name: skipThreeBytes
methods.description: Skips three specific bytes in JSON, used for skipping specific literals.
